lines.zh: 我跳一下，草叶才动一下。
lines.en: I hop once, and one blade of grass moves.
Three health — even my steps are light.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵先动，然后才是我。
lines.en: My ears move first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 我在垄沟里跳，避开你的脚。
lines.en: I hop along the furrow, dodging your feet.
A flick of my tail and I change direction.
I hop the fence and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 菜地里的叶子被我啃出缺口。
lines.en: The garden leaves have bites missing.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵在替它听方向。
lines.en: My ears are listening for it.

lines.zh: 这具小身体里塞了太多东西。
lines.en: Too much was stuffed into this small body.
I hop along your footprints.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，我蹿出去半丈。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs and I'm off.
Grass seeds stick to my belly.

lines.zh: 我踮着后腿，在你脚边画了半个圈。
lines.en: On my hind legs, I trace half a circle around your boots.
My hops land a little heavier than usual.
I hop the ridge, dodging the hoe.

lines.zh: 我的后腿比前腿更用力。
lines.en: My hind legs push harder than the front.
I crouch, nose moving without pause.

lines.zh: 耳朵转向你说话的方向。
lines.en: My ears turn toward your voice.

lines.zh: 我在嚼一片咬不烂的叶子。
lines.en: I'm chewing a leaf that won't break down.
With three health, I don't dare sleep.
My belly on cool soil feels good.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有雷。
lines.en: I hear thunder far away.
My burrow still holds a store of grass.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔前爪，尝到土味。
lines.en: I lick my forepaw and taste soil.
I sit perfectly still, like a stone.
Something on my back swells gently.
I'm waiting for dark to leave the burrow.
The wind blows; I shrink down.

lines.zh: 我的胡须量着洞口宽窄。
lines.en: My whiskers measure the burrow mouth.
It's too quiet; I don't like it.
I bury my nose in the grass.
The wind at my burrow blows inward.
You crouch down, so I watch you.

lines.zh: 我的红眼睛映着你的脸。
lines.en: My red eyes reflect your face.
Don't reach out; my bite is light.

lines.zh: 你手里是不是有胡萝卜？
lines.en: Is that a carrot in your hand?
I tilt my head, ears flattened.
You blink; I blink back once.

lines.zh: 这张小脸底下藏着东西。
lines.en: Something hides under this small face.
I'm staring at the tip of your boot.

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，我就退半步。
lines.en: You come one step; I give half.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子记住了你的味道。
lines.en: My nose has memorized your scent.

lines.zh: 你看我可爱，我看你危险。
lines.en: You see cute; I see dangerous.
The master looked at me like that too.
Don't hit me; I'll burst.
My ears are pressed flat to my back.
Three health — two left.

lines.zh: 我被拍得贴在栅栏上，慢慢滑下来。
lines.en: I am swatted flat against the fence and slide down slowly.
The pain makes my legs kick.

lines.zh: 你为什么要打一只兔子？
lines.en: Why would you hit a rabbit?
The thing inside me is ticking.

lines.zh: 我躲进草丛，血滴在叶子上。
lines.en: I hide in the grass, blood on the leaves.

lines.zh: 三点的血，只剩一点点了。
lines.en: Three hearts, and only a sliver is left.
My nose is bleeding.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜？我跳过去闻了闻。
lines.en: A carrot? I hop over and sniff it.
Dandelions smell better than carrots.

lines.zh: 你举着萝卜，我眼睛都直了。
lines.en: You hold up a carrot and my eyes go wide.
I'll take a bite and bolt; don't chase.
This carrot is unnaturally sweet.
I crouch by your hand and don't bite yet.

lines.zh: 金胡萝卜太重，我拖不动。
lines.en: A golden carrot's too heavy to drag.

lines.zh: 萝卜的甜味，让我的耳朵都软了。
lines.en: The sweetness of that carrot softens both my ears.

lines.zh: 我闻到萝卜，也闻到陷阱。
lines.en: I smell the carrot, and I smell a trap.
After this bite, I have to go.
Don't touch my ears; I'm eating.

lines.zh: 萝卜叶子更好吃，你摘错了。
lines.en: The tops taste better; you picked wrong.

lines.zh: 我抱着萝卜，像抱着宝贝。
lines.en: I hug the carrot like a treasure.

lines.zh: 你喂我，是想要我留下吧。
lines.en: Feeding me means you want me to stay.
That carrot gets three sniffs first.

lines.zh: 你把叶子朝下拿，我够得着。
lines.en: Hold the leaves low and I can reach.
I explode when I die. Keep back.
I bounce away from your feet.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵撞到你的小腿。
lines.en: My ears bumped your shin.
Don't nudge me with your foot.

lines.zh: 我死后会炸，你最好走开。
lines.en: I explode when I die. Best step back.

lines.zh: 三点的血，经不起这么碰。
lines.en: Three health can't take much bumping.

lines.zh: 我撞在你靴尖上，翻了个跟头。
lines.en: I hit the tip of your boot and tumble head over heels.

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡住我的洞口。
lines.en: Your boot is blocking my burrow.

lines.zh: 我跳上你的鞋面又跳下去。
lines.en: I hopped onto your shoe and off again.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我心跳快了半天。
lines.en: One bump and my heart races for ages.

lines.zh: 洞里那窝小兔不是我生的。
lines.en: The litter in the burrow isn't mine.

lines.zh: 我这样的，生下来就是死的。
lines.en: Ones like me are born already dead.
I smell a doe, and I want to hide.
The master doesn't need more rabbits.
They all scatter when I come near.

lines.zh: 这具身体里塞着别人的意思。
lines.en: Someone else's will is packed in this body.
I was changed before I could pair.
The burrow's crowded; I sleep outside.

lines.zh: 我记不住自己有几个孩子。
lines.en: I can't remember how many young I had.

lines.zh: 别把我跟普通兔子放一起。
lines.en: Don't put me in with ordinary rabbits.

lines.zh: 我叼起你掉的胡萝卜，跑了。
lines.en: I grab your dropped carrot and run.

lines.zh: 我用前爪扒拉地上的面包。
lines.en: I paw at the bread on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把你的缰绳咬断了一截。
lines.en: I chewed a length off your lead.

lines.zh: 捡东西时我耳朵一直转。
lines.en: My ears keep turning while I pick things up.
I rolled two circles hugging the apple.
The smell of gunpowder excites me.

lines.zh: 我把东西藏在草堆下面。
lines.en: I hide it under the hay pile.
The bone's too hard for my teeth.
Carrying something, I run slower.
Your dropped arrow works as a stick.
You stepped on my burrow entrance.
I don't fight, but I hold grudges.
The master points at you and bids me come close.

lines.zh: 你身上有胡萝卜的味道。
lines.en: You smell of carrots.
I watch you, waiting for you to stoop.
Don't chase me; chasing me ends badly.
I've circled behind you.

lines.zh: 这具身体想跑，又不想跑。
lines.en: This body wants to flee, and doesn't.
You're holding a blade.
I'm counting the steps between us.

lines.zh: 我蹲在原地，耳朵对着你。
lines.en: I crouch where I am, ears aimed at you.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我就绷紧一下。
lines.en: Every move you make tightens me up.
My hind legs are already loaded.
Don't try to corner me.

lines.zh: 我身上的东西开始发热。
lines.en: The thing inside me is getting warm.
Three health disappears in one hit.
I'm pretending to eat grass.
Come closer and I stop retreating.
The master says to wait until you swing.
My nose won't stop twitching.
I bit your ankle once.
My hind legs kicked your shin.
That barely hurt you at all.
I hang on to your trouser cuff.
Don't hit back; I can't take it.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的鞋带，使劲往后扯。
lines.en: I clamp onto your shoelace and yank backwards.
You kicked me off, and I lunged again.
I scratched the back of your hand.
That bite was a warning.
Panting, I backed off two steps.
The hay moved, and I came out.

lines.zh: 我从洞里探出头，眼睛是红的。
lines.en: I poke my head from the burrow, eyes red.

lines.zh: 主人把我放在这片菜地。
lines.en: The master set me down in this garden.
Three health — anyone can kill me.
My ears show above the grass first.

lines.zh: 这窝兔子昨晚还是普通的。
lines.en: This litter was ordinary last night.

lines.zh: 我身上还沾着洞里的土。
lines.en: I still have burrow dirt on me.

lines.zh: 田里少了一只兔子，多了我。
lines.en: The field lost a rabbit and gained me.
I landed with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我体内装着火药。
lines.en: Small as I am, there's gunpowder inside me.
One touch of flame and my fur singes.
Falling from a height left my legs weak.
Water reached my ears; I paddled hard.
The blast rolled me into the ditch.
An arrow grazed my back.
The potion made my fur stand up.
The garden's been empty three days.
The thunder froze me stiff.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有菜叶，我什么都抓不到。
lines.en: No leaves out here in the void; my paws catch nothing.
